## Appearances

The treetop lookout appears only in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Skyline Valley* update.

## Behind the scenes

- A cut interior cell also named treetop lookout remains in the game's files, though it is unknown what relation it had to this lookout, as well as what purpose it would have served.
